definitions.explanation: A line that extends in both directions without curving.

examples.japanese: {定規|じょうぎ}で{直線|ちょくせん}を{引|ひ}く。
examples.english: Draw a straight line with a ruler.

examples.japanese: {二|ふた}つの{点|てん}を{結|むす}ぶ{直線|ちょくせん}は{一|ひと}つしかない。
examples.english: There is only one straight line connecting two points.

examples.japanese: この{道|みち}は{直線|ちょくせん}で10キロ{続|つづ}く。
examples.english: This road continues straight for 10 kilometers.

notes:
{直線|ちょくせん} refers to a straight line in geometry.

CONTRAST:
- {直線|ちょくせん}: straight line
- {曲線|きょくせん}: curved line

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {直線|ちょくせん}を{引|ひ}く: to draw a straight line
- {直線|ちょくせん}コース: straight course
- {直線|ちょくせん}{距離|きょり}: straight-line distance
